verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own docs list 'Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)' and 'automated remediation across endpoints', so some fleet-wide actions are first-party capabilities. Both are only one-line marketing mentions, and nothing shows a general way to select many items and run one action on them. missing for 10: documented general-purpose bulk actions across devices/users/items, bulk endpoints or batch operations in the Web API, detail on multi-device remote script execution, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
